RTN UMA JHAWAR PROMOTES EYE DONATION AWARENESS AMONG COLLEGE STUDENTS IN INDORE
Indore, 29 October 2026: Spreading the message of eye donation and inspiring the younger generation to become ambassadors of this noble cause, Rtn. Uma Jhawar, a proud member of the Rotary Club of Organ Donation International (RCODI) and owner of M K Eye Bank, Indore, conducted an eye donation awareness initiative at Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Government Arts and Commerce College, Indore.
